_comment: Example of the update manifest served at updates.vanam.aivafreelancia.in/manifest.json. See docs/OTA-RELEASES.md section 4. Keep the cache TTL at 5 minutes or less so a forced update actually propagates.
_comment_minSupported: Installed builds BELOW this code get an undismissable update prompt. Leave it at the oldest still-acceptable build; raise it only to push a security fix.
_comment_apkUrl: Immutable, version-stamped filename. Never overwrite a published APK — roll forward to a new versionCode instead.
_comment_sha256: sha256sum of the APK. The app verifies this before handing the file to the installer and refuses a mismatch.
releaseNotes: Faster message loading and a fix for Telugu text wrapping.
